timing_schedule: Rotate strategy order for each intent and round, synchronized accelerator; 80 warm samples per strategy
gallery: Reuse each model own matched frozen image index; validate all records and image hashes
english_source: Existing frozen manually authored English pair; no online translator; English preparation/translation excluded from latency
metric_unit: 8 intents, one ranking per strategy per intent; do not treat16bilingualstrings as16independenttasks
method: Average cosine scores with equal language weights, without renormalizing the weighted query vector
limitations: Same pilot already used for diagnosis; not independent validation
AI-assisted labels and English pairs, not independent human ground truth
Capacity and native image resolution both differ
score_stability: Reject any repeated/historical rank drift or max absolute cosine-score drift above1e-5 before publishing results.
